problems.reason: Both sentences state the Barremian age of Pelecanimimus.
Sentence 22 discusses the Rambla de Las Cruces II limestone unit, a geological formation, not a feature of the animal itself.

Sentence 18 claims Pelecanimimus lived at the beginning of the Cretaceous (~145 Ma) but gives an age of ~125 Ma and identifies the Barremian stage, while sentence 19 correctly places it in the Barremian (125.77–121.4 Ma). The two statements conflict on the temporal placement.
